text:
rachel: quick follow-up from today's rollout sync  want a compact "escrowed-safeguard" flow for A/B canaries that keeps billing predictable and avoids flip-flop.
ben: yeah. key constraints: per-tenant cost accounting, small memory footprint in the edge, and predictable ordering for fallbacks.
omar: thinking of an "escrow" concept: when you divert traffic to a variant you atomically reserve a tiny budget token for that tenant so cost spikes are bounded. if budget exhausted then degrade to cached response.
kevin: interesting. how do we enforce it distributedly? centralized counters slow us down.
omar: keep a local soft-escrow counter in the edge (LRU by tenant), synced to control-plane every minute. control-plane sends occasional top-ups or hard-caps.
rachel: signals to use: sliding p95(20s), backend-queue, kv-hit, small-eval quality flag, and escrow-remaining. combine with a stability window.
ben: oscillation prevention: require condition hold for N seconds + cooldown. also attach a monotonic safepath-id so retries see same decision.
kevin: fallback ordering rules: prefer same-family lower-precision -> co-located sibling -> cached-last-good -> truncated summary. only cross-family if opt-in.
omar: session affinity: prefer fallbacks that keep KV continuity. if not available, serve cached-last-good and add x-safepath-warning header.
rachel: telemetry: emit reason codes: capacity, latency, quality_regression, escrow_exhausted, operator_override. include tenant_id, route, variant_id, safepath_id, token_delta_est.
ben: API sketch (text-line form): route=/v1/chat/generate safepath.enabled=true safepath.stability_s=3 safepath.cooldown_s=30 safepath.fallbacks=["rwi-8q","rwi-6b-q","cached_short"] safepath.escrow_tokens_per_min=50
kevin: runtime note: only maintain state for the N hottest tenants (configurable). cold tenants fall back to global defaults from control-plane. LRU eviction must be deterministic.
omar: warmup: async prefix-KV push to chosen fallback when warmup budget available; never block critical path by default.
ci-bot: deploy queued: escrowed-safepath-v0.1 -> canary scheduled 2026-08-11T14:00:00Z :rocket:
rachel: rollout plan: dry-run observe-only -> internal opt-in for 48h -> small external cohort. monitor fallback frequency, latency delta, and token-cost delta.
ben: ops playbook: page on fallback_rate >1% sustained 15m OR escrow_exhausted events >100 in 10m OR quality_regressions >3 in 1h. include console kill-switch.
kevin: tests: deterministic sim for spike patterns, integration for affinity preservation, chaos with region node loss. include unit tests for eviction semantics and hysteresis.
rachel: next: I'll draft RFC with DSL examples, safepath lifecycle, and a tiny simulator. will link here when ready :thumbsup:
